context: Add canonical writer provision and writer retire operations backed by Git porcelain and the owned-resource ledger. Record repository common directory, worktree administrative ID, canonical path, branch full ref, base SHA, and creation head. Decision gate: never remove a worktree or branch unless live Git identity matches the receipt, no active claim or process remains, the worktree is clean, and the accepted SHA is retained by an authoritative ref.
description: Make branch and linked-worktree creation and cleanup symmetric. Bossmode must reserve ownership before creating either resource, retain immutable Git identity and accepted-head evidence, and remove only clean, receipt-matched resources whose work is durably reachable. Dirty, changed, protected, foreign, or ambiguous resources keep closeout incomplete instead of being forced away.

anti_patterns.dont: Force-remove a dirty worktree or force-delete a branch
anti_patterns.instead: Keep closeout incomplete and report the exact blocking evidence
anti_patterns.why: That can destroy uncommitted or externally advanced work

anti_patterns.dont: Run git worktree prune as generic closeout
anti_patterns.instead: Reconcile and retire the exact receipt-matched target
anti_patterns.why: It can affect unrelated administrative entries

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a branch name or filesystem path as immutable ownership
anti_patterns.instead: Match Git common directory, administrative identity, full ref, and expected head
anti_patterns.why: Both can be deleted and reused

preserves.behavior: A changed owned branch is preserved and reported rather than reset or force-deleted.
Branch deletion occurs only after worktree removal and accepted-head reachability proof.
Primary, default, configured protected, externally created, dirty, and ambiguous Git resources are never deleted.
Worktree inventory ambiguity for an unrelated entry does not block a target whose identity is independently provable.

work_units.evidence: Idempotent retire: _fence_or_skip placeholder, retire_writer(worktree_path, branch, receipt, cwd) fences, runs target-scoped reconcile_writer_target, then git worktree remove <path> only if clean/matched (already gone => success), then git rev-parse --verify + merge-base --is-ancestor / branch --contains for accepted-head reachability, then git branch -d (not -D) only if unchanged; no --force, no broad prune. In git_runtime.py retire_writer.
